versions.changelog:
**Expanded model coverage and platform details with better integration notes.**

- Added explicit support for IMA Video Pro (Sevio 1.0), IMA Video Pro Fast (Sevio 1.0-Fast), and clarified support for Sonic v5 music generation.
- Updated platform description to emphasize unified access to all leading models (image, video, music, TTS).
- Improved credential/environment details, including which endpoints use the API key and when.
- Formalized persistence/logging retention and optional integration with ima-knowledge-ai documentation.
- Enhanced clarity in model reference tables and introduced dynamic model availability guidance.
- Minor keyword/description improvements for better discoverability and clarity.

No code or documentation changes detected in this version.

- No changes found compared to the previous release.
- Version or metadata may have been incremented/updated without file modifications.

- Updated skill name and description for broader clarity and searchability.
- Expanded keywords to include more supported models and variations, such as Pixverse, Hailuo, SeeDance, Vidu.
- No core logic or user-facing feature changes.
- All table references, workflow instructions, and model lists remain unchanged.

ima-all-ai 1.0.6

- Added 4 new files: `clawhub.json`, two script cache files, and `scripts/ima_create.py.backup`
- SKILL.md updated with a new "CRITICAL" section: now includes exact model_id reference tables for all image, video, music, and speech models to prevent errors from using friendly names
- Expanded keywords for improved discoverability and internationalization (Chinese/English)
- Command and model selection instructions are now clearer, with frequent warnings to always use the correct model_id string

- Added support for speech/TTS (text-to-speech/语音合成), including user input parsing and task routing.
- Updated descriptions and examples to include TTS as a supported media type.
- Expanded User Input Parsing table and instructions for handling speech requests and TTS-specific parameters.
- Clarified model and parameter selection for all media types, notably for TTS tasks.
- No code or implementation file changes; updates are documentation-only.

- Major cleanup: Removed documentation and metadata files (README.md, INSTALL.md, examples.md, SECURITY.md, change logs, etc.) and consolidated essentials.
- Added a minimal _meta.json for streamlined package metadata.
- SKILL.md updated: Concise description, clearer user input parsing and task routing instructions, and explicit fallback behavior if ima-knowledge-ai is not installed.
- Clarified workflow pre-checks and added prominent guidance for handling multi-media workflows and model selection.
- No functional API or code changes; this release is focused on documentation structure and user guidance.

- Added CLAWHUB_PUBLISH_CHECKLIST.md file.
- SKILL.md: Added mandatory notice to read the ima-knowledge-ai skill first (especially workflow-design.md and visual-consistency.md) before using for multi-step or multi-media tasks.
- Clarified that the knowledge base must be consulted for complex workflows, consistency, and model/video-mode selection; gave example scenarios and required decision branches.
- No changes to functionality—improvement is in user workflow guidance and explicit pre-check instructions.

Initial release of IMA Studio all-in-one AI content generation skill.

- Unified access to image, video, and music generation via IMA Open API.
- Always recommends and defaults to the newest and most popular models for each media type.
- Transparent documentation of network endpoints, data sent, and local storage for privacy-focused users.
- Requires an ima_* API key; security best practices and credential usage are clearly stated.
- Single skill covers multimodal workflows; dedicated skills available for image/video/voice-only use cases.
